name: Acrylfentanyl
metabolism: Evidence is from a peer-reviewed review of new fentanyl analogues (Gill et al., Front Pharmacol 2019, PMID 31024296). The metabolic pathway of acryloylfentanyl shows similarity with the pathways of fentanyl and acetylfentanyl. Overall, 14 biotransformation products were identified, including the major metabolites of acryloylfentanyl detected in human urine after hydrolysis, by human hepatocytes in vitro and in a few fatalities caused by acryloylfentanyl.
summary: Acrylfentanyl is a potent opioid analgesic and fentanyl analogue that has been sold online as a designer drug.
